about_the_game:
WASTELAND WARRIORS

In the dust-choked heart of the dead earth, where hope goes to die and bullets sing louder than prayers, walk the Warriors. Not heroes. Not soldiers. Just hardwired survivors with iron wills, rusted armor, and vendettas older than the sunburnt skyline.

FEATURES

  • Auto-firing/targeting drone mechanics

  • Hundreds of items and weapons

  • 4 player Co-Op locally

  • Survive 5 days worth of waves (from 30-60 seconds)

  • After day 5, test your build in Endless Mode

  • Unique characters with different stats to enhance builds

  • Hit the shop in between waves to buy different Drones and Items

Are you ready to take on the apocalypse? Grab your friends and prepare for battle in Wasteland Warriors!

content_descriptors.notes: Wasteland Warriors contains stylized, low-poly depictions of combat, including the killing of enemies. Additionally, the game features visual references to drugs and alcohol within the warriors' bunker environment, such as bottles and paraphernalia placed on shelves and tables. However, there is no depiction of consumption or usage by characters.
